text: I'm so tired, I've been up with him for hours. My son is 22 months, temp is 39.5. He's got a blotchy red rash on his chest that goes pale when I press a glass on it, but there are also tiny dark purple dots on his legs and those DON'T go when I press. He's really floppy, just lying on me, and he's hard to wake up. When I do get him awake he's not really looking at me or reacting like he normally would. His breathing is normal and his neck's ok, he can tip his head down to his belly. I don't know what to do
